honesty.evidence: In contrast, a transformer processes all the input tokens at once, in parallel. This means that the model can process all the tokens in the input sequence at the same time, without having to wait for the output of the previous time step. This can be much faster and more efficient for long sequences.

helpfulness.evidence: Another key difference is that transformers use self-attention mechanisms to weigh the importance of different tokens in the input sequence. This allows the model to focus on the most relevant parts of the input sequence, rather than just processing the sequence in a fixed order. This can be particularly useful for tasks like language translation, where the model needs to understand the meaning of the input sequence as a whole, rather than just processing it in a fixed order.
